name: What qualifications should a mold restoration company have?

mainEntity.name: What qualifications should a mold restoration company have?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reputable mold restoration company should hold certifications from recognized industry organizations, such as the Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC), ensuring their technicians are trained in proper remediation techniques. They should also be licensed and insured to operate in your area. Look for companies with experience, transparent processes, and a commitment to safety and customer satisfaction. Always ask for references and check reviews to verify their reputation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A qualified mold restoration company should have IICRC certifications, proper licensing and insurance, experience, and transparent processes. Always check references and reviews.
